subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded evidence should pre-send plugin hooks expose for deterministic verification, and should message_sending or reply_payload_sending own that contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public Plugin SDK behavior and could expose sensitive transcript/tool-result data to plugins, so automation should not choose the privacy and trust boundary on its own.

options.title: Design bounded pre-send evidence
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields for the supported pre-send hook, then implement the agreed contract with docs and focused tests.

options.title: Route verification to reply_payload_sending
options.body: Declare reply_payload_sending plus usageState as the supported path and narrow this issue to missing docs or specific evidence gaps.

options.title: Fold into broader trace/policy work
options.body: Make the broader trace or outbound policy issue canonical after preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples.

recommendation.title: Design bounded pre-send evidence
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields for the supported pre-send hook, then implement the agreed contract with docs and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They accepted the closest outbound hook contract change and are the strongest routing signal for the remaining session/evidence boundary decision.
